name: skillvault-list
title: SkillVault List
description: List global, discovered project, or explicit session skill folders with indexes, including unmanaged folders without skill.json, and uninstall selected skills by selector.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Action to run. Defaults to list.

inputs.name: selector
inputs.description: Indexes, ranges, comma lists, or keywords used for uninstall. Examples: 2, 1,3, 4-6, sync.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Optional scope filter. all includes global and discovered project skill folders. session is explicit only.
